purpose: Historical failure patterns used to ground the Module 13 taxonomy before new inference.

records.observation: Improved repository context increased evidence availability, but conceptual-task behavioral success remained absent.
records.localization: Relevant evidence being available was insufficient for successful downstream behavior.

records.observation: Several proposed edits were mechanically applicable but behaviorally wrong or incomplete.
records.localization: Mechanical applicability did not imply semantic correctness.

records.observation: Deterministic validation exposed invalid batches, but a single validation-feedback repair opportunity did not reliably recover them.
records.localization: Failure detection succeeded while model repair remained unsuccessful.

records.observation: Plan conditioning improved protocol validity, edit applicability, commit rate, and required-file coverage while behavioral success remained 1/8 in both direct and planned conditions.
records.localization: Improved decomposition and scope discovery did not resolve semantic implementation failures.

records.observation: A patch-only model reviewer falsely accepted multiple behaviorally incorrect patches.
records.localization: Independent model review was not a reliable substitute for deterministic execution evidence.

records.observation: Detailed execution evidence added context and inference cost and produced one truncated protocol failure, while the simpler deterministic PASS/FAIL signal already encoded the required verdict.
records.localization: Additional model inference did not add useful information over an existing deterministic signal.

records.observation: Adding bounded structured repository memory improved protocol validity from 2/3 to 3/3 but behavioral success remained 0/3.
records.localization: Additional repository evidence did not produce behavioral improvement in the tested task pairs.

records.observation: Across 15 repeated observations, behavioral success was 0/15 and the model finalized rather than using the available editing tools.
records.localization: The immediate observable failure occurred at the model-to-agent action-selection and completion boundary before patch generation.
